native_behavior: Traverse a linked list of layout nodes.
Use each node's one-based button index to select a 28-byte native button record.
Write left/top/right/bottom as signed 16-bit values; right and bottom are 16-bit wrapped sums of origin plus width/height.

project_search.decision: Translated from REA because the previous owner accessed native layout tables through absolute pointers.

limitations: Layout nodes must reference valid one-based button indices, matching the native table contract.
No game process or behavioral test was run.
